hero: A local repair garage interior: a compact car on a lift, a wheel-balancing machine, a pegboard of wrenches; through a high window, forested Laurentian hills in the distance. Flat vector, DARK overall (#162b30), accent highlights (#e5c966), white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands, no numbers. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems.
